title: Printing to console.
description:
Programs need to do somthing. _Duh_. The most common form of that is printing to console. To print to console in fortran, you use the following syntax:
```fortran
print *, "<text you want to print>"
```
e.g.
```fortran
print *, "Hello, World!"
```
